text:
Ana: NexusOps POC seeing 504 / socket hang up during streaming through their corporate forward proxy. Node 18 + @redwood-js v0.9.2. Streaming cuts out around 30s.
Sam: Paste error?
Ana: `FetchError: request to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat failed, reason: socket hang up`
Jordan: Likely proxy idle timeout closing long-lived SSE. Two options: buffered responses (no long-lived socket) or a dev client that sends keepalive frames.
NexusOps (customer): We can't change proxy. Prefer stable, no experimental installs.
Sam: Recommend `response_mode: 'buffered'` as quick fix. Small Node example: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, timeout: 120000 }); await client.chat.create({ model: 'rwd-1.0', messages: [{role:'user',content:'sum...'}], response_mode: 'buffered' });`
Ana: Also tell them buffered doesn't change per-token billing or quotas; just avoids streaming sockets. Increase app timeout to 2m for safety.
NexusOps (customer): OK we'll switch to buffered and increase timeout. Send the snippet and a short note on billing.
Sam: Sent snippet + billing note in DM. Closing unless they hit more issues. :thumbsup:
